title: A Quantum Support Vector Regression Framework for Missing Data Imputation in Ship Performance Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.22635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Internet of Ships enables vessels to generate vast amounts of data, yet missing values remain a persistent issue. To the best of the authors' knowledge, existing imputation techniques in this domain rely exclusively on classical machine learning. This study investigates quantum support vector regression (QSVR) for imputing missing values in ship performance data. Classical support vector regression and QSVR models based on different quantum feature maps are compared for estimating marine fuel consumption under varying levels of data availability. The case study uses real-world data from a Panamax bulk carrier, covering 37 variables across six categories. Three experiments are conducted: exploratory analysis with three input features, scalability analysis with increasing dimensionality (3 to 18 features), and comparative evaluation under a selected representative configuration. translated_title: 一种用于船舶性能数据缺失值填补的量子支持向量回归框架
translated_abstract: 船舶物联网（Internet of Ships）使船舶能够产生海量数据，但数据缺失值仍然是一个长期存在的问题。据作者所知，该领域现有的填补技术完全依赖经典机器学习。本研究探讨了量子支持向量回归（QSVR）在船舶性能数据缺失值填补中的应用。研究比较了经典支持向量回归（SVR）与基于不同量子特征映射的QSVR模型，在不同数据可用性水平下估计船舶燃油消耗。案例研究采用一艘巴拿马型散货船的真实数据，涵盖六个类别的37个变量。实验包括三项：使用三个输入特征的探索性分析、特征维度从3递增至18的可扩展性分析，以及在选定代表性配置下的对比评估。在所有场景中，经典与量子方法均……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究据称首次将量子支持向量回归（QSVR）应用于船舶性能数据的缺失值填补，通过在巴拿马型散货船真实燃油消耗数据上对比经典SVR与多种量子特征映射下的QSVR，验证了量子机器学习在船舶数据填补领域的可行性。
